understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, including moves blocked by walls; when stamina reaches zero, a life is lost and stamina resets, while losing all lives ends the game. Walls prevent movement, so the blocked_directions state must be checked before every move. Shape, color, and rotation modifier tiles change the corresponding piece attributes, and a goal activates only when all three attributes match. Activated goals still require physically stepping onto their cells to complete them.
